method: Editorial close reading of complete report texts and companions. Marks describe specified design commitments, not implementation completeness, novelty, or independent usability evidence.

dimensions.structures: Select structure data separately from proof properties
dimensions.checker: Denotation, checker soundness, and original-target bridge
dimensions.fidelity: Statement, method, and kernel truth distinguished
dimensions.evaluation: Matched Lean baselines and stopping rules

core.qualification: A conservative bidirectional elaborator; graph soundness is a relative paper theorem, not compiler verification.

anchor.qualification: Views retain the exact expression; support closes free variables of both proof and proposition under telescope dependencies.

structures.qualification: Packing differs from local refinement; explicit structure/automation profiles; nonzero, regular, and unit are distinct.

behavior.qualification: Consequence variance and composition retain the actual intermediate; total preconditioned functions differ from restricted-domain functions.

bounded.qualification: Request-wide budgets and acyclic proof assembly; unrelated facts must not change meaning, but proof choice and runtime can change.

observation.qualification: Jet observation of a fixed root; residual/branch/unit bridge and derivative demand; sufficient precision need not be weakest.

leant.qualification: Preserve current callback/epoch authority; require original behavioral proof and realizable original-domain negative witnesses.

checker.qualification: Explicit sparse integer denotation and ideal-certificate paper soundness; normalization, checked execution, and exact atom reification remain production work.

fidelity.qualification: Freeze statement meaning; check every asserted node; a named method and broad proof search have distinct explanation contracts.

evaluation.qualification: Five nested arms isolate library, services, property index, and frontend; already-short controls and semantic reading; library/index/renderer may be sufficient.

core.qualification: Conservative translation recommended; explicit kernel refinement alternative analyzed rather than claimed implemented.

anchor.qualification: Evidence rows belong to fully resolved terms and scoped telescopes; branch joins require case elimination.

structures.qualification: First-class packaging retains dependencies; temporary bundle adapters preserve maps and operation dictionaries.

behavior.qualification: Explicit consequence variance, retained-intermediate composition, and multi-input relational/naturality specifications.

bounded.qualification: No principal-refinement promise; finite cheap worklist over fixed anchors distinguished from budgeted term-generating search.

observation.qualification: Endpoint deletion yields a norm-error relation; reindexing, norm equality, locality, and finite precision remain distinct.

leant.qualification: Current host-shaped Length surface and scoped receipts acknowledged; direct composition, certified decisions, or exact-target proof search must supply behavioral evidence.

checker.qualification: Closed affine-length paper soundness/completeness with realizability; structural Lean model omits coefficient normalizer and reflection bridge.

fidelity.qualification: Meaning/evidence/search annotations distinguished; by/hint/solve differ; missing premise does not establish mathematical falsity.

evaluation.qualification: Four arms isolate packaging, refinement typing, and frontend; charge adapter costs and stop at library if it explains benefit.

core.qualification: Local overlays and lawful-use signatures compile to ordinary Lean; proposed primitive refinements require a conservativity argument and measured need.

anchor.qualification: Exact values, contexts, branch coverage, and source origins retained; support is not claimed mathematically minimal.

structures.qualification: Chosen ring operations, topology, measure, and actions are semantic inputs; proof irrelevance cannot choose or identify structural data.

behavior.qualification: Contract application and dependent intermediate-witness composition are explicit; relational weakening is illustrated, but a separate full pre/postcondition variance theorem is not developed.

bounded.qualification: Demand-driven bounded transitions and fun_prop reuse; route failure is not falsity or a license to shrink the requested domain.

observation.qualification: Lawful-use signatures distinguish point/neighborhood/almost-everywhere/coefficient guarantees and residual identification of an existing root.

leant.qualification: Length handoff correspondence is narrower than original behavioral truth; operational statuses and non-realizable abstract witnesses cannot refute the original target.

checker.qualification: Sparse integer operation denotation and certificate paper proof; source equality and checked execution are separate missing implementation obligations.

fidelity.qualification: Named reasons constrain method; final kernel validity does not prove statement/rendering intent or unused assertions.

evaluation.qualification: Matched service baseline and renderer-only treatment; satisfiable test contexts and semantic reading; library or renderer can be sufficient.
